figures.label: Exam Registration Fee
figures.source: NPTEL, the government-backed course platform run with the IITs and IISc, states that joining a course is free, including videos, study material and assignments. Its FAQ lists a certification exam fee of Rs 1000 per course.

figures.label: Education Budget Example
figures.source: An illustration, not a real fee: on a Rs 1 lakh budget for skills during the degree, a tenth is Rs 10,000 for one course. The rest can fund a laptop upgrade, a domain name and hosting for a project, an exam fee when a post asks for a certificate and a reserve.

items.text: YouTube lessons from working engineers, and official documentation for the language or tool.
NPTEL and other free public courses, with the paid exam only if a certificate helps.

Free tiers of cloud platforms and free practice platforms for coding problems; check the current terms first.
Internships, even unpaid short ones, and team projects at college.
